_comment: One entry per Connect IQ store listing. The map is compiled into the app,
so a listing covers exactly one region -- see docs/PUBLISHING.md.
app_id is the listing's identity in the store and MUST NOT change once the
app is published: a new id is a new listing with no users and no ratings.
Generate one with: python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4().hex)'
bbox is west,south,east,north. Keep the pack inside the budgets in
docs/PACKER.md -- tools/build-city.sh fails the build if the packer warns.

berlin.note: Inside the Ringbahn. Dense: needs the tighter point budget to keep the renderer from truncating before it covers the screen.
